model_annotations.Bulgarian: Тази стълбовидна диаграма представя сравнение на стойностите на точността на различни модели или методи, означени със съответните категории върху хоризонталната ос, като Mathverse, MMLU и Physics. Вертикалната ос показва точността като процент, с етикет "Accuracy (%)", диапазон от 50 до 62 и равномерно разположени числа на интервали от 2. Категориите са подредени в произволен ред без определена закономерност. Диаграмата изобразява данни за няколко групи, всяка със свой собствен цвят и шарка, които са следните: DAPO+Self-reflection, DAPO, SRPO, GRPO, PPO+Self-reflection и PPO. Някои от стълбите са с еднаква височина в рамките на отделните категории, докато други са различни. Представителни стойности са следните: при Mathverse, DAPO+Self-reflection е около 56%, а PPO е около 53%; при MMLU, SRPO е около 58%, а GRPO е около 54%; при Physics, DAPO+Self-reflection е малко над 60%, а PPO+Self-reflection е малко над 58%. Някои стълби са визуално подчертани чрез цвят и шарка. Няма допълнителна информация относно типа на скалата, освен че е линейна.
model_annotations.Chinese: This bar graph compares the accuracy of various methods across three categories: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The vertical axis represents accuracy as a percentage, labeled from 50 to 62 in increments of 2, with no units specified. The horizontal axis lists the three categories. Each category contains six bars, representing DAPO+Self-reflection, DAPO, SRPO, GRPO, PPO+Self-reflection, and PPO, distinguished by different colors and patterns. In Mathverse, the bars range from approximately 53 to 56 percent, with DAPO+Self-reflection and SRPO at the higher end. In MMLU, the bars range from about 54 to 57 percent, with DAPO+Self-reflection and SRPO again at the higher end. In Physics, the bars range from roughly 55 to 61 percent, with DAPO+Self-reflection showing the highest accuracy. The bars are not sorted in any specific order within each category, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color and pattern distinctions.
model_annotations.English: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy of various methods across three categories: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled as Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics, in a linear order. The vertical axis represents the accuracy as a percentage, labeled as "Accuracy (%)", with a scale ranging from 50 to 62, marked in increments of 2. The chart features grouped bars, with each group consisting of six bars, representing different methods: DAPO+Self-reflection, DAPO, SRPO, GRPO, PPO+Self-reflection, and PPO. The bars are colored according to a legend provided in the top right corner. The DAPO+Self-reflection bars have approximate values of 56%, 57%, and 61% for Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics, respectively. The DAPO bars have approximate values of 53%, 55%, and 54%. The SRPO bars have approximate values of 56%, 58%, and 61%. The GRPO bars have approximate values of 54%, 55%, and 56%. The PPO+Self-reflection bars have approximate values of 54%, 56%, and 58%. The PPO bars have approximate values of 52%, 54%, and 56%. The bars are not sorted in a specific way, and no bars are visually emphasized. The chart presents a clear visual representation of the accuracy of each method across the three categories.
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm zeigt die Genauigkeit verschiedener Methoden in drei Kategorien: Mathverse, MMLU und Physics. Die y-Achse stellt die Genauigkeit in Prozent dar und ist von 50 bis 62 beschriftet, mit einem Intervall von 2. Die x-Achse listet die drei Kategorien auf. Es gibt sechs verschiedene Methoden, die durch unterschiedliche Farben und Muster dargestellt werden: DAPO+Self-reflection (blau), DAPO (blau gestreift), SRPO (orange), GRPO (orange gestreift), PPO+Self-reflection (grün) und PPO (grün gestreift). In jeder Kategorie gibt es sechs Balken, die die Genauigkeit für jede Methode darstellen. Die Balken sind nicht in einer bestimmten Reihenfolge sortiert. Für Mathverse liegen die Werte bei etwa 53 für DAPO und PPO, 54 für GRPO und PPO+Self-reflection, 56 für SRPO und 57 für DAPO+Self-reflection. Für MMLU liegen die Werte bei etwa 54 für PPO, 55 für DAPO und GRPO, 56 für PPO+Self-reflection, 57 für SRPO und DAPO+Self-reflection. Für Physics liegen die Werte bei etwa 55 für PPO, 56 für PPO+Self-reflection und DAPO, 58 für GRPO und SRPO und 61 für DAPO+Self-reflection.
